## Activity

During October 2024, Central Eye Clinic completed 213 captures as part of routine service activity. The recorded activity provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes during the month. The site should continue to maintain complete and timely capture records to support monitoring of service performance and follow-up where required.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.9. This result should be reviewed alongside local operating conditions and any issues identified during image acquisition. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead. Recording these issues consistently will help support investigation and resolution and may assist with reducing avoidable ungradable images.

## Grading

A total of 51 results were graded referable during October 2024. The median grading lag was 2 days. This measure should continue to be monitored with the site’s activity and image-quality results to identify any change in performance. The available results indicate that grading activity was completed within the reported median lag, while referable outcomes and ungradable captures remain important areas for routine operational review.
